column1: # dark-factory corpus-bench manifest (#1490 sibling; see ../README.md and README.md in this dir).
# Columns (TAB-separated): id  code_repo  judging_repo  project_subdir  role  scope_hint
#   id             short slug used for work-dir naming and --id selection.
#   code_repo      GitHub "<org>/<repo>" of the CONCLUDED contest's audited code (cloned read-only, never
#                  modified).
#   judging_repo   GitHub "<org>/<repo>" whose README.md is the compiled report (ground truth: accepted H/M
#                  findings + "Found by" watson lists = rarity). Public only after the contest concludes.
#   project_subdir REQUIRED. Every Sherlock code_repo here is a wrapper repo (top-level README.md + ONE nested
#                  project dir) — the actual Foundry/Hardhat project root is <code_dir>/<project_subdir>, not
#                  the clone root. run-corpus-bench.sh's --hunt stage points run-zone-hunt.sh --repo at this
#                  subdir. Verified present (foundry.toml or hardhat.config.ts) on 2026-07-13.
#   role           REQUIRED, `dev` or `holdout` (#2231 hold-out policy). `dev` = a contest the lenses were
#                  DESIGNED on (its ground truth sat in bug-taxonomy.md's `seen:` lines until 2026-09-16), so
#                  every recall number measured on it is IN-DISTRIBUTION and must be labelled as such.
#                  `holdout` = never used to design a lens; recall CLAIMS are only made here. Readers print
#                  the role next to every per-contest headline (run-corpus-bench.sh, generation-recall.sh).
#                  role sits BEFORE the optional scope_hint on purpose: with IFS=TAB a `read` collapses an
#                  empty field, so a role appended AFTER a blank scope_hint would land in scope_hint. All
#                  positional readers were updated instead (see README.md "Adding a contest").
#   scope_hint     optional map-zones.sh --scope-hint restriction (comma/space list of files or dir-prefixes);
#                  blank = let zone-mapper.ag auto-discover the in-scope surface.
# Provenance: all 8 rows are Sherlock contests, chosen (2026-07-11 session) as a corpus spanning contest size/
# domain; GT counts below are informational (re-derived live by extract-gt.sh from each judging_repo, never
# hand-entered) and were verified by direct clone+grep on 2026-07-13: dodo=17 yieldoor=17 crestal=7 yearn=3
# plaza=30 notional=37 mellow=15 symm=6 (total 132). No contest code or finding text is re-hosted here.
